papers.title_en: ZoomSEM: accelerating large-scale brain connectomics with intelligent SEM super-resolution
papers.authors: Jiateng Shou, Zhiwei Xiong, Ruikang Xu, Zhicheng Wang, Peiyao Shi, Te Shi, Haiqun Jin, Chunying Yin, Jun Guo, Manfred Auer, Hanchuan Peng, Ruobing Zhang, Feng Wu
papers.evidence: 深度学习扫描电镜超分辨率加速脑连接组学
papers.tldr: 大规模脑连接组学依赖串行电镜，但立方毫米级成像常需数月甚至数年，吞吐量成为核心瓶颈。ZoomSEM 利用真实低/高分辨率 SEM 配对训练深度超分模型，可从快速低分辨扫描重建 4×、8× 乃至 16× 高分辨图像，并保留关键神经元精细结构。实验在多种生物样本上验证了真实低分辨采集下的稳健泛化，实现最高约 30 倍有效加速。该工作为高速大体积高分辨串行电镜成像提供实用方案，有望推动连接组学及相关领域。
papers.abstract_en: Serial electron microscopy (EM) is essential for large-volume biological imaging and connectomics, yet its throughput remains a major bottleneck, with cubic-millimeter-scale brain imaging requiring months or years. Existing deep learning-based EM super-resolution methods are limited to small upscaling factors or rely on synthetic data, offering modest acceleration and limited practical impact. We introduce ZoomSEM, a deep learning-based super-resolution method to dramatically accelerate SEM imaging. Trained on real low- and high-resolution scanning electron microscopy (SEM) pairs, ZoomSEM enables reliable recovery of 4$\times$, 8$\times$, and up to 16$\times$ higher-resolution images from fast low-resolution scans while preserving fine neuronal structures critical for connectomic analysis, achieving up to 30-fold effective acceleration. Extensive experiments across datasets of diverse biological samples demonstrate robust generalization under realistic low-resolution acquisition. This advance enables high-resolution, large-volume serial EM imaging at unprecedented speed, poised to transform connectomics and related fields.
